title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior, você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas, APIs e serviços que compõem ao ecossistema de produtos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais:


  • Criar e manter APIs/Serviços, garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar sistemas para melhorar a performance.
  • Trabalhar na integração de sistemas internos e de terceiros.
  • Participar de reuniões para entendimento de requisitos, refinamento de demandas e planejamento de sprints.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) para garantir a estabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar sistemas/serviços em produção, analisando logs e métricas para garantir a estabilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento, proteção de dados e autenticação de sistemas.
  • Em conjunto com a liderança técnica e arquitetura, avaliar e propor novas ferramentas, tecnologias e práticas para melhorar o ecossistema da empresa
  • Documentar processos e melhorias implementadas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência em Java e outras linguagens de programação. (experiência mínima de 4 anos )
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Habilidade para identificar e solucionar desafios técnicos de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código com Git;
  • Noções de banco de dados PostgreSQL e Mongo;
  • Experiência com Quarkus ou Spring Boot ;
  • Busca constante por melhorias nos sistemas e processos existentes.
  • Capacidade de documentar código e comunicar ideias técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas: Busca contínua por aprendizado e soluções eficazes. Capacidade de colaborar em equipe, receber feedback construtivo e contribuir para o sucesso do projeto


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com sistemas legados desenvolvidos a partir do Java 8;
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação Node, Typescript, React e Angular;
  • Familiaridade e experiência com o uso de Docker para implantação e gestão de contêineres;
  • Experiência prévia com aplicativos de gerenciamento de caches e/ou sistemas de filas de eventos.



Por que #VemParaSyonet ? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Front-end Developer (React.js) - Project
description:
We are looking for a remote, skilled Senior Front-End Engineer with 5+ years of experience in React.js to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for shaping ideas and user feedback into delightful experiences, developing and implementing user interface components into the latest React.js concepts and workflows, and leading the engineering efforts for user-facing features. You will work with our product and user experience teams to deliver end-to-end features that deliver business value that users love.


This project has a 6-month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform allows companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the User Experience and Product teams to create end-to-end designs for new features
  • Take ownership of product features from design, implementation, and delivery, to post-delivery feedback and follow-up work
  • Coordinate development efforts across team members and ensure successful delivery
  • Architect, develop, and implement highly-responsive user interface components using JavaScript and React.js
  • Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, and help find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience as a front-end engineer writing single-page applications that communicate with API back-ends, and knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A well-developed understanding of frontend concepts and various frameworks
  • A focus on delivering value to customers
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field
  • Node.js and Python experience
  • Additional Information
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays annually
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger


The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET


SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.


We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.


The Role


As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.


You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.


This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:


  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing


Key Responsibilities


Academy & CE Content Development


  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform


Medical Marketing Content


  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation


Workflow-Connected Learning


  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities


Performance & Optimization


  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation


Requirements


  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms


Working Hours


  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm


*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.



Why Join SignalPET?


  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Sênior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera desenvolvedor, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando C# , Node.js e Python.
  • Vivência com serviços da AWS , incluindo Apache Flink, S3, EC2, ECS e SQS (entre outros serviços correlatos).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços , incluindo desenho, implementação e manutenção de serviços distribuídos.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com .NET e AWS.


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • NET Core, AWS;
  • Conceitos de microserviços e aplicações distribuídas;
  • Testes unitários;
  • Conhecimento em REST APIs;
  • Docker, Kubernetes;
  • Desenvolvimento em Cloud AWS;
  • RDS MySQL e DynamoDB, AWS Lambda utilizando Python, ECS Fargate, Elastic Cache Redis, API Gateway, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, KMS, etc;
  • SQL (SQL Server ou MySQL) e DynamoDB;
  • Serviço de Mensageria: KAFTA;
  • Experiência em CI/CD (CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild);

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java) - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Senior Backend Engineer (Java) position focuses on designing and developing sophisticated, scalable backend systems using Java technologies. This role involves leading technical initiatives, mentoring junior engineers, and creating high-performance, robust solutions that address complex business challenges while implementing microservices architectures and ensuring technical excellence across the team.


Key responsibilities


- Architecting and implementing complex, scalable backend services using Java and related technologies.

- Leading technical design and implementation of enterprise-level software solutions.

- Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to the team's technical excellence and best practices.

- Designing and optimizing database schemas and data access strategies for performance and scalability.

- Implementing microservices architectures and cloud-native applications.

- Conducting comprehensive code reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code across projects.


Requirements


- Backend Development: 4+ years of hands-on experience with Java backend development.

- Java Ecosystem: Strong expertise in Java ecosystem and enterprise application design.

- Architecture Knowledge: Advanced understanding of software architecture and design patterns.

- Modern Frameworks: Experience with Spring Boot, microservices, and cloud platforms.

- Database Expertise: Proficiency in database design and optimization techniques.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Corporate Content Creator
description:
Company Overview:

Lean Tech is a fast-growing technology company based in Medellín, Colombia, with a strong network in software development and IT services across the entertainment, financial, and logistics industries. The company offers significant opportunities for professional growth while working with engineering teams across Latin America and the United States on innovative projects. Lean Tech is seeking a Mid-level Corporate Content Creator & Training Evangelist to design and deliver high-quality multimedia training materials that communicate company initiatives, operational standards, and internal programs. This role combines content creation, instructional design, and corporate communication to transform complex operational and technical topics into clear, engaging materials such as documents, presentations, videos, and visual assets. The position will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance, and Business Application teams to identify knowledge gaps and develop scalable training programs that enhance employee performance and operational excellence.


Position title: Mid-level Corporate Content Creator

Location: Remote - LATAM


Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Corporate Communication

  • Develop high-quality written content including structured documentation, manuals, process guides, and corporate communications using tools such as Microsoft Word and Visio.
  • Produce professional video content, visual assets, and multimedia training materials that effectively communicate company processes, systems, and initiatives.
  • Create engaging PowerPoint presentations, PDF learning materials, and visual storytelling assets for internal education and corporate messaging.
  • Design and produce multimedia learning content including tutorials, explainer videos, diagrams, infographics, and process walkthroughs.
  • Ensure all content follows corporate communication standards, branding, and messaging consistency.


Training Program Design & Instructional Development

  • Design, develop, and implement training curriculums tailored to employee roles and operational requirements.
  • Build structured learning programs including:
  • Best practices
  • Work instructions
  • Process documentation
  • Continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain and facilitate training curriculum, demonstrations, documentation, and certification programs for employees across different operational areas.
  • Develop training programs for New Hire Onboarding and Continuous Development, including defined milestones and certification expectations.
  • Create training frameworks that support different learning styles and modern learning methods (visual, video-based, interactive).


Training Delivery & Evangelization

  • Act as a corporate evangelist for training initiatives, promoting adoption of best practices and operational standards across the company.
  • Facilitate training workshops, demos, and learning sessions for internal teams.
  • Drive adoption of training content and learning initiatives through clear communication and engaging delivery methods.


Training Strategy & Performance Monitoring

  • Define and analyze training effectiveness metrics, measuring performance, adoption, and knowledge retention.
  • Monitor training program outcomes to ensure alignment with company standards, compliance policies, and operational procedures.
  • Continuously improve training content based on data insights, feedback, and operational changes.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Business Application Owners, Operations Leadership, Product, Technology, and Compliance teams to identify training gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Work with stakeholders across regions to ensure training programs reflect operational differences by region, station, carrier, mode of transport, or client requirements.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure data quality, process improvements, and workflow alignment within training materials.

Process & Content Governance

  • Maintain structured documentation repositories and ensure training materials remain current and aligned with evolving company processes.
  • Support workflow optimization and documentation standardization across departments.
  • Contribute to training roadmaps and long-term learning strategies.

Required Skills & QualificationsProfessional Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in content creation, corporate training, instructional design, or learning and development roles.
  • Proven experience producing multimedia training materials including documentation, presentations, video, and visual content.
  • Experience designing corporate training programs and internal knowledge frameworks.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and global organizations.

Content & Media Creation Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools.
  • Experience creating professional training videos and visual content.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design and modern learning methodologies.
  • Ability to produce structured, well-written documentation with excellent editorial quality.
  • Experience with camtasia or other video and image editing.
  • Experience with Adobe reader or other tools to generate content

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong storytelling ability to transform technical information into engaging content.

Analytical & Organizational Skills

  • Strong research and analytical skills to identify training opportunities and learning gaps.
  • Ability to analyze training metrics and continuously improve programs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Strong collaboration skills across distributed and global teams.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous environments and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.
  • Empathy for end users to design intuitive and practical learning experiences.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate training, knowledge management, or learning experience design.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS).
  • Experience in global operations environments such as logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
  • Knowledge of project management frameworks and backlog management tools.

Why you will love Lean Tech:

  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels.


Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Lean Tech is seeking a Mid-level Corporate Content Creator & Training Evangelist to design and deliver high-quality multimedia training materials that communicate company initiatives, operational standards, and internal programs. This role combines content creation, instructional design, and corporate communication to transform complex operational and technical topics into clear, engaging materials such as documents, presentations, videos, and visual assets. The position will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance, and Business Application teams to identify knowledge gaps and develop scalable training programs that enhance employee performance and operational excellence.


Position title: Mid-level Corporate Content Creator

Location: Remote - LATAM


Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Corporate Communication

  • Develop high-quality written content including structured documentation, manuals, process guides, and corporate communications using tools such as Microsoft Word and Visio.
  • Produce professional video content, visual assets, and multimedia training materials that effectively communicate company processes, systems, and initiatives.
  • Create engaging PowerPoint presentations, PDF learning materials, and visual storytelling assets for internal education and corporate messaging.
  • Design and produce multimedia learning content including tutorials, explainer videos, diagrams, infographics, and process walkthroughs.
  • Ensure all content follows corporate communication standards, branding, and messaging consistency.


Training Program Design & Instructional Development

  • Design, develop, and implement training curriculums tailored to employee roles and operational requirements.
  • Build structured learning programs including:
  • Best practices
  • Work instructions
  • Process documentation
  • Continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain and facilitate training curriculum, demonstrations, documentation, and certification programs for employees across different operational areas.
  • Develop training programs for New Hire Onboarding and Continuous Development, including defined milestones and certification expectations.
  • Create training frameworks that support different learning styles and modern learning methods (visual, video-based, interactive).


Training Delivery & Evangelization

  • Act as a corporate evangelist for training initiatives, promoting adoption of best practices and operational standards across the company.
  • Facilitate training workshops, demos, and learning sessions for internal teams.
  • Drive adoption of training content and learning initiatives through clear communication and engaging delivery methods.


Training Strategy & Performance Monitoring

  • Define and analyze training effectiveness metrics, measuring performance, adoption, and knowledge retention.
  • Monitor training program outcomes to ensure alignment with company standards, compliance policies, and operational procedures.
  • Continuously improve training content based on data insights, feedback, and operational changes.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Business Application Owners, Operations Leadership, Product, Technology, and Compliance teams to identify training gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Work with stakeholders across regions to ensure training programs reflect operational differences by region, station, carrier, mode of transport, or client requirements.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure data quality, process improvements, and workflow alignment within training materials.

Process & Content Governance

  • Maintain structured documentation repositories and ensure training materials remain current and aligned with evolving company processes.
  • Support workflow optimization and documentation standardization across departments.
  • Contribute to training roadmaps and long-term learning strategies.

Required Skills & QualificationsProfessional Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in content creation, corporate training, instructional design, or learning and development roles.
  • Proven experience producing multimedia training materials including documentation, presentations, video, and visual content.
  • Experience designing corporate training programs and internal knowledge frameworks.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and global organizations.

Content & Media Creation Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools.
  • Experience creating professional training videos and visual content.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design and modern learning methodologies.
  • Ability to produce structured, well-written documentation with excellent editorial quality.
  • Experience with camtasia or other video and image editing.
  • Experience with Adobe reader or other tools to generate content

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong storytelling ability to transform technical information into engaging content.

Analytical & Organizational Skills

  • Strong research and analytical skills to identify training opportunities and learning gaps.
  • Ability to analyze training metrics and continuously improve programs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Strong collaboration skills across distributed and global teams.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous environments and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.
  • Empathy for end users to design intuitive and practical learning experiences.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate training, knowledge management, or learning experience design.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS).
  • Experience in global operations environments such as logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
  • Knowledge of project management frameworks and backlog management tools.

Why you will love Lean Tech:

  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels.


Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Office of the CEO Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Office of the CEO Analyst position focuses on analyzing, defining, and continuously improving processes across the organization while working on high-impact initiatives directly sponsored by executive leadership. This role offers unique exposure to strategic priorities and cross-company operations, providing the opportunity to identify systemic issues, propose solutions, and drive measurable impact through process optimization and automation in a hyper-growth environment.


Key responsibilities


- Analyzing and defining processes, detecting systemic issues, and proposing solutions while leading or supporting the execution and implementation of improvements.

- Identifying automation and efficiency opportunities within executive administrative scope, documenting processes for scalability and long-term effectiveness.

- Filtering, classifying, and routing executive communications through appropriate channels, applying judgment and business context to prioritize matters requiring leadership attention.

- Serving as the primary point of contact for day-to-day executive communication and coordination.

- Supporting cross-functional initiatives that require executive sponsorship, helping translate strategic priorities into structured execution plans.


Requirements


- Process Experience: Demonstrated background working with processes and operations management.

- Methodical Approach: Strong organizational skills with a process-driven and detail-oriented mindset.

- Analytical Capabilities: Proven ability to analyze complex situations and identify improvement opportunities.

- Language Proficiency: Good level of English.


Benefits:

title: Desenvolvedor(a) IOS Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) iOS para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicativos mobile para o ecossistema Apple. Essa pessoa será responsável por construir novas funcionalidades, evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações e garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade do código .


Buscamos alguém com boa autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade do código e que goste de colaborar com times multidisciplinares.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicativos iOS utilizando Swift
  • Escrever código limpo, organizado e de fácil manutenção
  • Traduzir protótipos e designs em interfaces funcionais e bem estruturadas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com designers, desenvolvedores backend e outros membros do time
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e contribuir para evolução da arquitetura das aplicações
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs e problemas de performance
  • Realizar integração com APIs e serviços backend
  • Acompanhar tendências e boas práticas do ecossistema iOS


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Domínio da linguagem Swift
  • Domínio de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO)
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces utilizando Auto Layout e Interface Builder (Storyboards e XIBs)
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura MVVM
  • Familiaridade com design patterns como Delegate, Notification e Injeção de Dependências
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de dependências utilizando CocoaPods
  • Conhecimento dos frameworks nativos da Apple e das Human Interface Guidelines
  • Experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful e manipulação de JSON
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git (Gitflow)
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Experiência com publicação e gerenciamento de aplicativos na App Store
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de software mobile
  • Experiência com automação de testes para aplicações mobile
  • Experiência com Firebase
  • Experiência com integração com APIs e SDKs nativos do iOS


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Hunter Comercial
description:
O profissional será responsável por toda a jornada de prospecção e qualificação de novos leads, desde a abordagem inicial até a elaboração e apresentação de propostas de serviços da empresa. Atuará estrategicamente para identificar novas oportunidades de negócio, realizar abordagens ativas e engajar leads com as soluções oferecidas pela empresa.


Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar ativamente contas estratégicas e decisores B2B;
  • Realizar o atendimento de novos leads provenientes do Inbound MKT;
  • Realizar abordagens iniciais para identificar necessidades e desafios dos leads;
  • Realizar a qualificação de leads, conforme processo interno;
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas aos leads qualificados;
  • Realizar follow-up de negociações e acompanhamento de novos contratos;
  • Monitorar métricas, metas e OKRs relacionadas à prospecção e qualificação de leads;
  • Contribuir com insights para a melhoria contínua das estratégias comerciais da empresa.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência ou formação na área de energia elétrica
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa e vendas B2B
  • Técnicas de qualificação de leads e vendas consultivas
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel

title: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix
description:
Vaga: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix

Local: Brasil (remoto)

Área: Produto / Tecnologia / Varejo

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner especialista em ERP Linx Microvix para liderar a evolução de soluções voltadas ao varejo. Este profissional será responsável por traduzir necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades de produto, garantindo que o ERP atenda às demandas operacionais, fiscais e estratégicas de redes varejistas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Definir e gerenciar o roadmap do produto relacionado ao ERP Linx Microvix.
  • Priorizar e organizar o backlog de produto , criando e refinando user stories.
  • Traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros para o time de desenvolvimento .
  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre stakeholders e equipes técnicas .
  • Conduzir sessões de refinamento de backlog, planejamento de sprints e reviews .
  • Definir critérios de aceite e validar entregas do time de desenvolvimento.
  • Mapear processos de varejo e propor melhorias operacionais dentro do sistema.
  • Participar da definição e acompanhamento de releases e versões do produto .


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada com ERP Linx Microvix .
  • Experiência como Product Owner, Product Manager ou Analista de Produto .
  • Conhecimento profundo de operações de varejo .
  • Experiência com metodologias Agile / Scrum .
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação funcional e regras de negócio .
  • Conhecimento em integrações de sistemas e APIs.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com POS de varejo ou soluções omnichannel .
  • Conhecimento em meios de pagamento e carteiras digitais
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia voltadas para varejo.

Competências comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico
  • Comunicação clara entre áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Visão estratégica de produto

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Calculista, Projeto Elétrico Transformadores de Força - Orçamentista
description:
Funcionário, Freelance, Contrato, Terceiro ou Temporário

Remoto, Híbrido ou Presencial

Mínimo 2 anos de experiência na área


Sobre a empresa

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. é uma empresa brasileira especializada no projeto e fabricação de transformadores de potência para concessionárias e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior.

A empresa integra o grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , companhia global de tecnologia energética sediada nos Estados Unidos, ampliando sua atuação internacional e capacidade de inovação.

Esse momento de expansão cria oportunidades de desenvolvimento técnico, crescimento profissional e participação em projetos de engenharia de alta complexidade no setor elétrico . ⚡


Descrição da vaga

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. , empresa do grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , busca profissional para atuar como Projetista / Calculista Elétrico de Transformadores de Potência , integrando a área de Orçamentos e Engenharia de Vendas .

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de estudos técnicos, dimensionamento e elaboração de propostas para transformadores de potência até 345 kV , destinados ao mercado nacional e internacional , atuando em interface com as áreas de engenharia, comercial e clientes.


Principais atividades:

  • Realizar dimensionamento de transformadores de potência (reatância, perdas, correntes, impedâncias, esforços de curto-circuito, etc.);
  • Elaborar memoriais de cálculo e folhas de dados técnicas para propostas;
  • Analisar especificações técnicas de clientes (ET / RFQ) e normas aplicáveis;
  • Definir configurações técnicas e construtivas dos equipamentos para atendimento às especificações;
  • Apoiar a área comercial na elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais ;
  • Interagir com clientes e equipes internas para esclarecimentos técnicos durante o processo de oferta ;
  • Participar da avaliação técnica de riscos e viabilidade de fornecimento .


Perfil desejado:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica ;
  • Conhecimento em transformadores de potência e seus princípios de projeto ;
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas do setor (IEC / IEEE) ;
  • Capacidade de análise técnica, organização e comunicação com diferentes áreas;
  • Inglês técnico será considerado diferencial.


O profissional terá a oportunidade de atuar em projetos de engenharia para sistemas elétricos de alta complexidade , contribuindo para soluções destinadas a utilities e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior . ⚡

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for HungerRush Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all HungerRush Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:


  • Provide first class Technical Support over the phone
  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls
  • Work closely with other departments to provide prompt resolutions to customer

issues


Education :

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)
  • Preferred – Associates Degree (or higher)


Experience:

  • Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in computer technology (prior help desk or call center experiences supporting a software product a big plus)
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Technical certifications (examples: Net+, CompTIA A+ or an AAS degree or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in the hospitality industry
  • Familiarity with POS equipment
  • Bilingual Speaker (preferable) (Spanish/English)


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

title: Talent - Performance Specialist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role


The Talent Performance Specialist will transform complex data into strategic insights that directly improve individual performance and operational outcomes across Talent Acquisition, working closely with senior stakeholders to become a strategic analytics reference.


Key Responsibilities:


- Consolidating, validating, and maintaining performance dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.

- Analyzing individual and team performance metrics, identifying trends, outliers, and recurring issues to generate actionable, data-driven insights for Talent Acquisition operations.

- Defining, tracking, and evolving KPIs for existing and new Talent Acquisition roles.

- Partnering with Operations and Automation teams, acting as the main point of contact for dashboard changes, data logic updates, and reporting improvements.


Requirements:


- Experience: 2-4 years as a Performance Analyst, Business Analyst, or Data Analyst.

- Performance Metrics: Experience with individual performance KPIs and operational metrics.

- Data Review: Involvement in data-driven performance review processes.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (complex formulas, data validation, querying).

- Experience consolidating data from multiple sources.

- Analytical Skills: Strong understanding of KPIs, trends, outliers, and performance metrics.

- Language: Advanced proficiency in English.


Desirable Skills:


- Experience with Looker Studio or Databricks.

- Basic to intermediate SQL.

- 4+ years in analytics roles linked to Talent, Operations, or QA.

- Experience in fast-growing or scaling environments.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: JR Partnership Programs Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

description:

title: Business Analyst (BA)
description:
I am reaching out because we are in need of a new Business Analyst (BA) resource for our team, and I would like to request your support. Below are the details of the profile we are seeking:


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our team and support initiatives related to our Core Banking systems. This professional will act as a key bridge between business and technology, ensuring clarity of requirements, alignment across teams, and effective delivery of solutions in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support Agile ceremonies, including:
  • Daily Scrum (when necessary)
  • Backlog Refinement
  • Sprint Planning
  • Sprint Review
  • Sprint Retrospective (as observer or contributor)
  • Conduct requirements gathering and process analysis
  • Prepare and maintain the product backlog
  • Organize and manage dependencies across teams
  • Validate deliverables to ensure alignment with business needs
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders
  • Leverage JIRA for tracking, documentation, and workflow management

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Experience with Core Banking systems, including:
  • DDA Accounts
  • Savings Accounts
  • Money Market Accounts
  • Certificates of Deposit (CD)
  • Hands-on experience working in Agile teams
  • Strong knowledge of banking processes and system integration
  • Proven experience with:
  • Requirements gathering
  • Backlog preparation and refinement
  • Dependency management
  • Delivery validation
  • Proficiency with JIRA

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with JHA (Jack Henry & Associates) environment

title: Executive Headhunter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The Executive Headhunter position focuses on identifying, attracting, and assessing top talent for senior-level positions. This role combines executive search methodology with talent assessment expertise to place high-performing leaders who can drive organizational success and strategic growth for clients.


Key responsibilities:


- Conducting in-depth interviews and evaluations to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, cultural fit, and potential.

- Designing and executing customized search strategies to identify high-caliber talent for executive or senior-level roles.

- Facilitating the offer process, including salary negotiations and contract discussions, to ensure smooth placements.

- Proactively identifying and attracting top-tier candidates through networking, referrals, market research, and digital platforms.


Requirements:


- Experience: At least 5 years in recruitment, preferably in executive search.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Psychology, Human Resources, or related field.

- Market Knowledge: Experience recruiting for US candidates and commercial openings.

- Assessment Skills: Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.

- Industry Understanding: Knowledge of various industries and executive roles.

- Work Style: Ability to work independently and manage multiple search assignments.

- Language Skills: Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Estágio em Customer Success

A Risposta é uma plataforma de inteligência e satisfação de clientes para restaurantes. Hoje estamos presentes em mais de 1.500 casas em todo o Brasil , incluindo grupos como Outback, Aizomê, Moma, Rascal, Origem, entre outros.

Usamos tecnologia e dados para ajudar restaurantes a oferecer experiências cada vez melhores aos seus clientes. Se você tem interesse em experiência do cliente, tecnologia e relacionamento , e quer aprender em um ambiente dinâmico, queremos te conhecer.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Community Manager
description:
Você vive futebol no dia a dia, acompanha tendências, transforma lances em conversa e sabe como criar interação real nas redes sociais? O Jogo a Jogo procura um(a) Community Manager para cuidar da relação com a nossa comunidade.


Falamos de esportes e apostas com uma linguagem leve, criativa e próxima do público brasileiro, sem abrir mão de informação, contexto e responsabilidade editorial. Procuramos alguém que saiba equilibrar resenha, timing e leitura de comunidade.


Devido à natureza do calendário esportivo, e em particular para a cobertura da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, é desejável flexibilidade de horário para cobrir online os jogos que serão transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, gosta de futebol para além do placar e entende o valor de construir comunidade — queremos conhecer você.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e publicar conteúdos diários para Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok e outras redes;
  • Monitorar menções e interagir com o público de forma criativa e respeitosa;
  • Estar atento(a) a trends, memes e momentos do futebol para gerar engajamento;
  • Colaborar com o time editorial para alinhar prognósticos, posts e campanhas;
  • Criar e redigir e-mails de marketing para a base de usuários do Apostas no IG ou em conjunto com os outros projetos e sites do grupo.
  • Acompanhar métricas e propor novas estratégias para aumentar o alcance.
  • Realizar a cobertura online da Copa do Mundo durante o período da contratação, incluindo interações e posts em tempo real sobre os jogos transmitidos da América do Norte (Canadá, EUA e México).


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia com social media ou community management;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas gráficas (Adobe photoshop,Illustrator etc) e edição de vídeo (Capcut,Riverside, After Effects etc);
  • Fluência em português brasileiro (conteúdo voltado para o público do Brasil);
  • Paixão por esportes, especialmente futebol;
  • Escrita criativa e ágil, com domínio de linguagem digital;
  • Organização para lidar com demandas rápidas e calendário editorial;
  • Noções de métricas e ferramentas de gerenciamento de redes sociais e CRM (Hubspot, RD Station, Optimove etc);
  • Disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário para cobrir eventos e jogos online, em especial durante a Copa do Mundo.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência na gestão de perfis de humor ou entretenimento esportivo;
  • Habilidade para criar memes, reels ou vídeos curtos;
  • Conhecimento de SEO e tendências do universo esportivo online.


Local de Trabalho

Híbrido para quem morar em Porto, Portugal. Remoto para demais localidades.


Modelo de Contratação

Contratação Pessoa Jurídica / MEI


Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se pelo botão do LinkedIn.

Se tiver dúvidas e/ou quiser enviar portfólio adicional, escreva para:
