title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Remote – Brazil

Mode: Contract


About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript, combined with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.

• Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines.

• Perform data modeling, data transformation, and integration between systems.

• Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to ensure high-quality data solutions.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability.

• Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

Required Skills & Experience

• 6+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript.

• Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling.

• Strong understanding of APIs, backend architecture, and data integration patterns.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Excellent communication skills in English or Portuguese.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions.

• Familiarity with GraphQL or REST API development.

• Knowledge of data governance, data security, and compliance.

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: Vendedor externo - Advisory
description:
Quem somos nós:

A Skintec é uma empresa referência em tecnologias para medicina estética e bem-estar, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado . Atuamos ao lado de médicos e clínicas que buscam inovação, segurança e resultados consistentes, oferecendo soluções tecnológicas de alto padrão, respaldadas por evidências científicas e certificações internacionais.

Mais do que tecnologia, entregamos suporte especializado, relacionamento de longo prazo e desenvolvimento para nossos parceiros . Nosso time é movido pela Cultura WOW , que valoriza pessoas, excelência e a superação de expectativas.

Skintec — conectando tecnologia, pessoas e excelência médica.


Resumo do desafio:

Realizar venda consultiva, desenvolvendo negócios e gestão de contas, prospectar e realizar a

gestão de carteira de clientes da Skintec, foco em Medical e clientes chave de cada região.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em mercado de luxo e clientes de alto padrão;
  • Vivência anterior com Medical Devices ou corretatos;
  • Forte atuação em negociações de alto ticket e vendas consultivas;
  • Habilidades com CRM.



Condições:

Contratação PJ, estamos trabalhando com pretensões salarias e condições compatíveis do mercado.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Hands‑on AWS operations (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch).
  • Azure operations experience (VMs, VNet, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB).
  • Strong troubleshooting & incident management (cloud, on‑prem, Linux/Windows).
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep/ARM, CDK).
  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, Bash).


And much better if you stand out for:

  • Familiarity with containerization technologies beyond basics (Docker + Kubernetes in production).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (routing, load balancing, security).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows focused on reliability, patching, backup & DR.
  • Ability to create and maintain operational runbooks and documentation.
  • Prior participation in on-call rotations and leading post‑incident reviews.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and support AWS (primary) and Azure (secondary) cloud environments.
  • Handle tickets, incidents, troubleshooting, and root‑cause analysis.
  • Maintain core AWS and Azure services, including compute, networking, security, and Kubernetes.
  • Monitor performance, capacity, cost, and proactively resolve risks.
  • Execute changes through change management with minimal disruption.
  • Support hybrid cloud connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS).
  • Participate in on‑call rotation and lead post‑incident reviews.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and automate tasks with scripting.
  • Contribute to CI/CD and DevOps workflows for stability, patching, backup, and DR.


Key Words:

  • AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch)
  • Azure (VMs, VNet, NSG, AKS, Entra ID, Firewall, LB)
  • Kubernetes & Docker
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM)
  • Scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash)
  • Hybrid Cloud (VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, DNS)
  • Incident Management & Troubleshooting
  • CI/CD & DevOps
  • Monitoring & Performance Optimization

description:

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Marketing & Product Designer
description:
As a Marketing-Focused Visual & UI Designer at ProjectMark, you will help shape how our brand and product story show up across customer communications, our Help Center, and educational content like tutorials and feature walkthroughs. This role is heavily focused on improving the experience for our current client base by making information clearer, more consistent, and easier to access. You will also contribute to growth marketing efforts, including campaigns, paid ads, and website experiences.

We’re looking for someone who is tech-forward and curious by default, constantly exploring more efficient ways to work and leveraging modern, bleeding-edge tools (including new design, automation, and AI capabilities) to increase output quality and speed. While you will support product design (UX/UI) when needed, your primary goal is to partner with Marketing and Customer Success to improve acquisition, adoption, and retention through clear messaging, strong educational content, and high-quality design execution. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product Design, Sales, and Engineering to turn ideas into polished assets and experiences that support both business goals and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities


Customer Communication & Lifecycle Assets

  • Design visuals and templates for customer emails, in-app announcements, release notes, webinars, and product updates.
  • Create on-brand resources that improve clarity and consistency across customer touchpoints.


Help Center & Education Content

  • Improve the Help Center experience through visual guidelines, layouts, illustrations, and content structure.
  • Create reusable article templates, diagrams, feature walkthroughs, and lightweight UI visuals that make documentation easier to scan and understand.
  • Partner with Customer Success to prioritize content based on support insights and feature releases.


Marketing & Growth Design 

  • Create and iterate on assets for paid ads, social media, email/newsletters, blog visuals, landing pages, and campaign materials.
  • Partner with Marketing to concept and execute campaigns, ensuring consistent brand quality across channels.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation by producing variants quickly and consistently.


Website & Conversion Optimization

  • Collaborate with Marketing and Product to improve website structure, messaging hierarchy, and visual design to increase conversions.
  • Review analytics, heatmaps, and session replays to identify friction points and propose design improvements.
  • Design or refine landing pages and key website sections, keeping accessibility and performance in mind.


Sales & Operations Enablement 

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product sheets, case studies, and pricing visuals.
  • Design assets for events, webinars, internal presentations, and leadership updates as needed.


Product Design Support

  • Support the product design team with UI execution when needed, including new screens, flows, and improvements.
  • Help maintain and evolve the Design System to ensure brand and UI consistency across product and marketing surfaces.


Asset Management & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain an organized, scalable asset library (campaigns, templates, sectors, use cases).
  • Help refine and document brand guidelines and visual standards so execution stays consistent across the team.


What We’re Looking For


  • Strong experience in visual design with a portfolio that includes marketing assets (ads, landing pages, email, brand systems) and digital product/UI work.
  • Proven ability to design for clarity and adoption, creating resources that help customers understand, trust, and use the product.
  • High proficiency in Figma and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (or equivalent tools).
  • Solid understanding of typography, layout, hierarchy, and brand consistency across multiple channels.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Tech-forward mindset: actively explores new tools, workflows, and bleeding-edge technology to work smarter, improve speed/quality, and continuously optimize how the team designs and delivers work.
  • Advanced or fluent English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience designing within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with basic UX principles and designing within design systems.


Nice-to-Have Skills


  • Familiarity with performance marketing concepts (creative testing, funnels, conversion-focused design).
  • Experience with HubSpot (emails, templates, workflows).
  • Motion or video editing skills (short product demos, social video, feature highlight clips).
  • Copy sensibility (Ability to contribute to marketing and product copy, helping draft and refine messaging for ads, landing pages, emails, and in-app/customer communications.).


Submitting your resume and portfolio in English is preferred.

title: Junior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks / Python / Spark
description:
Role: Data Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term (Through Dec 2026)

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: 8am - 5pm CST

Location : 100% Remote


We are seeking a Junior Data Engineer with experience in Azure Databricks, Python, and Apache Spark to build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. The role involves developing ETL/ELT pipelines, optimizing data processing, and supporting cloud-based data platforms in an Azure environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory
  • Build and optimize Apache Spark jobs for large-scale data processing
  • Work with Python and SQL to transform and analyze data
  • Support data architecture using Delta Lake and Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Collaborate with product owners and analytics teams to deliver reliable data solutions

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of Data Engineering experience
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong Python and SQL skills
  • Experience building ETL pipelines
  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory and cloud data platforms

Nice to have: Azure certifications, streaming data experience, or infrastructure-as-code knowledge.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Soluções IA
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos Desenvolvedores(as) de IA para atuar na criação de soluções inovadoras utilizando inteligência artificial aplicada ao setor financeiro.



O DESAFIO:


  • Colaborar com time de AI para transformar demandas das unidades de negócio, ou backoffice em modelos e pipelines de ML/IA escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Analisar e preparar grandes volumes de dados para treinamento
  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).
  • Habilidades sólidas de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente em um ambiente remoto.
  • Experiência com sistemas multiagentes.
  • Experiência multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Participar ativamente na avaliação de riscos técnicos (performance, escalabilidade, segurança) e colaborar na aplicação de soluções preventivas.
  • Colaborar na criação de documentação técnica



O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python e Java
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL)



O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ


️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer | Data Engineering & GenAI (GCP)
description:
Sobre a vaga:


Operamos em duas frentes: a Plataforma Unificada de Pessoas, voltada a People Analytics e diagnóstico organizacional, e projetos de consultoria estratégica baseados em dados para grandes marcas globais. No lado de consultoria, construímos plataformas de analytics, modelos preditivos e camadas de IA generativa que alimentam decisões comerciais de alto nível, incluindo projetos para CPGs com presença em toda a América Latina.


Estamos contratando um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na interseção entre engenharia de dados, modelagem e IA em produção. O escopo é amplo por design: somos pequenos. Não há um engenheiro dedicado só a pipelines e outro só a modelagem. Você faz os dois, e precisa saber quando priorizar cada frente. O trabalho de consultoria é concreto: pegar dados de múltiplas fontes (sell-in, sell-out, P&L, market share, distribuição), estruturar pipelines que não quebrem toda semana, construir modelos que vão para produção de verdade, e desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa sobre esses dados. A plataforma interna de People Analytics caminha em paralelo, com modelagem de diagnóstico organizacional e integração de LLMs nos fluxos de produto.



Responsabilidades:


  • Estruturar e orquestrar pipelines de dados (BigQuery, GCP) com monitoramento real;
  • Harmonizar múltiplas fontes com nomenclaturas inconsistentes e atualizações diárias;
  • Construir modelos preditivos (XGBoost/LightGBM) e simuladores de cenário;
  • Colocar ML em produção: APIs (FastAPI), versionamento (MLflow, DVC), monitoramento de drift;
  • Desenvolver camadas de Q&A com IA generativa usando RAG, Vertex AI e LangChain;
  • Trabalhar direto com produto, tech lead e fundador — e eventualmente apresentar resultados para executivos de clientes globais.



Requisitos:


  • Superior completo em Ciência da computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de software ou áreas afins;
  • Python sólido e SQL avançado;
  • GCP na prática: BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud Run;
  • Orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Prefect ou similar) — não só saber o que é, mas ter feito;
  • ML em produção de verdade, não apenas notebooks;
  • Familiaridade com LLMs, RAG e LangChain;
  • Experiência com Metabase ou ferramenta de BI equivalente para entrega de insights a stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado para leitura técnica, documentação e contexto com clientes;
  • Perfil autônomo: sabe definir própria agenda dentro de objetivos claros.


Perfil valorizado: Quem já trabalhou com dados de negócio fora de grandes empresas de tecnologia — CPG, varejo, RH, mercado financeiro. A lógica de sell-in/sell-out, P&L e market share não é óbvia para todo mundo. Se você já navegou nesses contextos, vai se adaptar muito mais rápido.

title: Analista de Devops Sr
description:
Com o que você irá atuar:


  • Administrar ambientes em nuvem (principalmente AWS), garantindo performance, disponibilidade e segurança
  • Automatizar processos com ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou AWS CDK
  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD integradas à infraestrutura
  • Monitorar recursos de cloud usando CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana ou similares
  • Gerenciar recursos como EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, ELB, Route53, entre outros
  • Suportar o time de desenvolvimento em deploys, testes e troubleshooting de infraestrutura
  • Apoiar na definição e implementação de políticas de segurança, backup e governança em cloud
  • Participar de projetos de migração, modernização e otimização de workloads para nuvem
  • Integrar práticas de segurança no ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software
  • Interagir com as equipes de desenvolvimento para implementar controles nas plataformas Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Automatizar testes e integrar ferramentas no pipeline de CI/CD.
  • Gerenciar e monitorar a configuração das infraestruturas em nuvem e on-premise.



O que esperamos de você?


  • Experiência prática com serviços AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, etc.)
  • Vivência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em automação de ambientes e CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Noções de redes, segurança em cloud e boas práticas de arquitetura
  • Habilidade com sistemas Linux e scripts (bash, python, etc.)
  • Experiência com práticas em ambientes de desenvolvimento com Dotnet, Node.js e Python.
  • Experiência em configuração de servidores Web com IIS, Nginx e Apache.



O que oferecemos como benefícios:


  • VR
  • Vale transporte
  • Assistência médica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Day Off de Aniversário
  • Gympass

title: Archer System Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um(a) System Engineer Sênior com experiência em ARCHER e ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS) , para atuar no planejamento, engenharia e sustentação da infraestrutura de sistemas da organização.

O(a) profissional será responsável por upgrades, versionamentos, rotinas de manutenção e por garantir a estabilidade, performance e evolução dos ambientes tecnológicos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Archer IT Controls Engineer dentro do modelo de governança de risk management.
  • Realizar manutenções, ajustes e criação de novos módulos dentro da plataforma Archer.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de tecnologia e governança.
  • Trabalhar com alto nível de autonomia e organização.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (principalmente AWS) e apoiar rotinas de infraestrutura.


O que você precisa ter

  • Conhecimento avançado em RSA Archer (criação, customização e manutenção de módulos).
  • Forte background de infraestrutura .
  • AWS – indispensável (principal ambiente utilizado).
  • Azure – conhecimento desejável .
  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos de sistemas, redes e comunicação.
  • Vivência com upgrades, versionamento e rotinas de manutenção.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em SQL e bancos de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas corporativas (Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de desenvolvimento e CI/CD (GitHub, PowerShell, JavaScript, .NET ) e com gestão de mudanças (ITIL) .



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Estamos em busca de um(a) System Engineer Sênior com experiência em ARCHER e ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS) , para atuar no planejamento, engenharia e sustentação da infraestrutura de sistemas da organização.

O(a) profissional será responsável por upgrades, versionamentos, rotinas de manutenção e por garantir a estabilidade, performance e evolução dos ambientes tecnológicos.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Archer IT Controls Engineer dentro do modelo de governança de risk management.
  • Realizar manutenções, ajustes e criação de novos módulos dentro da plataforma Archer.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas de tecnologia e governança.
  • Trabalhar com alto nível de autonomia e organização.
  • Atuar em ambientes cloud (principalmente AWS) e apoiar rotinas de infraestrutura.

  • Conhecimento avançado em RSA Archer (criação, customização e manutenção de módulos).
  • Forte background de infraestrutura .
  • AWS – indispensável (principal ambiente utilizado).

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Familiaridade com práticas de desenvolvimento e CI/CD (GitHub, PowerShell, JavaScript, .NET ) e com gestão de mudanças (ITIL) .

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Project Description:

  • The Anaplan Technical Lead is an experienced multi-skilled professional with hands-on experience in Anaplan model development/Support experience. He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support.


Responsibilities:

  • • Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
  • • Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
  • • Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
  • • In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
  • • Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
  • • Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
  • • Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
  • • Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
  • • Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
  • • Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
  • • Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
  • • Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
  • • Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
  • • Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
  • • Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.
  • • Prior work experience in Anaplan Support projects.
  • Availability to work in US Central Time
  • Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis
  • • Good communication skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • • Basic knowledge of Cloud Services
  • • Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps
  • • Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
  • • Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

title: Python Developer
description:
Position: Python Engineer

Location: Remote in Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, or Costa Rica


Must Haves:

  • Expert-level Python (microservices, APIs, async patterns, testing)
  • Strong experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems patterns
  • Experience working with Databricks platform, using it to run Spark jobs, notebooks, etc.
  • Experience with Spark / Spark Streaming for batch + streaming jobs
  • Experience with Kafka and streaming/event-based integrations; familiarity with Avro schemas
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and data-driven applications Cloud experience in GCP and/or Azure Experience with containerization

Day-To-Day:

  • Design and develop Python-based microservices (REST/async services) with strong API contracts and clean service boundaries
  • Build and integrate event-driven services using the Kafka ecosystem (including Kafka Streams concepts where applicable) and schema-based messaging (Avro)
  • Implement batch and streaming workloads that support downstream systems (Spark / Spark Streaming), leveraging Databricks for job execution and notebooks when needed
  • Collaborate with product and engineering partners to evaluate architecture, define requirements, and deliver scalable features

  • Design and develop Python-based microservices (REST/async services) with strong API contracts and clean service boundaries
  • Build and integrate event-driven services using the Kafka ecosystem (including Kafka Streams concepts where applicable) and schema-based messaging (Avro)
  • Implement batch and streaming workloads that support downstream systems (Spark / Spark Streaming), leveraging Databricks for job execution and notebooks when needed
  • Collaborate with product and engineering partners to evaluate architecture, define requirements, and deliver scalable features

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.



Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.


About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.


Job Responsibilities:

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.
  • Provide strong talent pipeline support and help build talent succession plans for business departments.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.


Nice to have

  • Experience working in Chinese companies or multicultural, Asia-influenced environments.


Interested in joining Keeta?

Check out our open positions! When applying, your information will be securely stored and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates.

title: Senior Mineral Resources Consultant
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Somos uma consultoria especializada em Recursos Minerais e Inteligência Artificial aplicada à mineração .

Atuamos em projetos técnicos estratégicos para empresas de mineração no Brasil e no exterior, integrando:

-Geoestatística avançada e moderna

- Estimativas e simulações de recursos

- Automação e workflows reprodutíveis

- Programação aplicada à geociência

- Inteligência Artificial para suporte técnico e tomada de decisão


Desenvolvemos soluções modernas que elevam o padrão técnico dos projetos, combinando rigor metodológico com eficiência operacional e inovação tecnológica.


Sobre a Posição


Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) Sênior de Recursos Minerais para atuar como responsável técnico(a) por projetos , liderando estudos de alta complexidade e garantindo excelência nas entregas e apoiando no desenvolvimento da nossa solução de IA, MineMind.


Essa posição é ideal para quem combina:


profundidade técnica + visão de projeto + mentalidade tech

Você será peça-chave na integração entre geociência, engenharia de minas e inteligência artificial.



Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de Recursos Minerais ponta a ponta
  • Conduzir estimativas de recursos minerais
  • Executar simulações geoestatísticas condicionais
  • Aplicar machine learning em desafios geocientíficos
  • Estruturar fluxos de trabalho automatizados e auditáveis
  • Desenvolver e manter scripts técnicos
  • Garantir qualidade, rastreabilidade e padronização das entregas
  • Atuar como referência técnica junto a clientes e equipes



Requisitos Técnicos Recursos Minerais & Geoestatística

  • Experiência sólida em geoestatística aplicada à mineração
  • Vivência comprovada em estimativa e classificação de recursos minerais
  • Experiência prática com simulações condicionais



Softwares de Mineração

Experiência com ferramentas como:

  • Studio RM
  • Leapfrog Geo e Leapfrog Edge
  • RMSP
  • Outros softwares de modelagem e geoestatística


IA & Tecnologia (Perfil IA-Driven)

  • Familiaridade com uso de IA no fluxo de trabalho técnico
  • Capacidade de operar ferramentas como:
  • Assistentes técnicos corporativos (ex: MineMind)
  • Modelos de linguagem como OpenAI ChatGPT e Anthropic Claude
  • Ferramentas de agentes de IA como Manus
  • Mentalidade orientada à automação, eficiência e inovação


Idiomas

  • Português — fluente
  • Inglês — diferencial importante
  • Espanhol — diferencial



Programação & Automação

  • Python básico para automação e análises técnicas
  • Scripting básico em softwares de mineração
  • Interesse em estruturar workflows técnicos inteligentes

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Company Description

Scandinavian Capital Markets is a foreign currency broker based in Stockholm with a remote workforce. We are building the next generation of currency trading technology and products, and we are looking for someone who can work independently and think outside the box. If you are someone who excels at mobile technologies, but also wants to have a voice in high-level decisions such as architecture and product, we want to meet you!


Role Description

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

title: iOS Engineer (Swift)
description:
Salary: 55 LPA INR


Position Overview – Senior iOS Engineer

We are seeking experienced iOS engineers who enjoy working closely with cross‑functional teams and who bring strong architectural thinking, product sensibility, and a deep understanding of modern iOS development.

This role involves supporting a large and diverse user base, evolving the mobile application with new features, and ensuring high performance and quality across devices.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to plan, design, and deliver new application features.
  • Work together with backend/API developers and other mobile engineers to maintain a scalable, reliable, and well‑structured app ecosystem.
  • Continuously explore new iOS technologies and propose improvements to enhance product quality and user experience.
  • Participate in code reviews, refine development processes, and contribute to technical decision‑making.
  • Improve workflows, documentation, and collaboration practices within the engineering team.
  • Stay current with iOS platform changes and apply best practices to ongoing development.

Mandatory Requirements

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6+ years of iOS development experience using Swift .
  • Minimum 1 year of hands‑on development using SwiftUI .
  • Deep understanding of modern iOS features and platform best practices.
  • Experience working with mid‑complexity mobile architectures (e.g., MVVM , VIPER , Clean Architecture , etc.).
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD platforms such as Bitrise or Jenkins.
  • Solid understanding of software design principles (e.g., SOLID , design patterns).
  • Familiarity with automated mobile testing (Unit, UI, Smoke Testing, etc.).
  • Strong communication skills, empathy, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Motivated to work in a team‑based product environment.
  • Strong sense of UX, attention to detail, and focus on usability.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with reactive programming frameworks.
  • Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) or behavior-driven development (BDD).
  • Knowledge of performance profiling, debugging, and optimization on iOS.
  • Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation and guidelines.
  • Experience in travel‑related products or services.

title: Mainframe System Engineer
description:
Mainframe System Engineer

Location – Brazil Remote



Job Overview:


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Mandatory Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:
  • IBM OMEGAMON for Storage
  • IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm
  • IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)
  • IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)
  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems
  • CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).
  • CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).
  • IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation, operational considerations).
  • CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits


  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Must Haves

  • 1+ year of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python or Java development experience, including API development, model training, testing, and general backend engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ingestion workflows, or ETL processes
  • Experience evaluating the quality of Search or Generative AI systems
  • Strong communication skills; able to work independently while providing clear, consistent updates to the team
  • Collaborative team player who is proactive in sharing knowledge and contributing to team best practices

Plusses

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience using LangChain to build LLM workflows with tools, memory, and retrieval
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other Lucene-based search technologies
  • Experience with Airflow
  • Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures


Day to Day

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (one Mid-Level and one Senior) to join a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and quality engineers. In this role, you will contribute to an enterprise-grade, end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system.

Responsibilities span the full lifecycle, including content ingestion and pipeline development, indexing and retrieval quality improvements, answer generation, and system evaluation. You will work on experimentation, model development, ETL workflows, search relevance, and evaluation frameworks. The role includes deploying code to non-production environments and supporting production releases in collaboration with the DevOps team. This is primarily a hands-on individual contributor role, with an expectation of clear communication, collaboration, and active participation in team discussions and planning.

title: Desenvolvedor PHP Pleno
description:
Oportunidade 100% Remoto e PJ


Estamos buscando desenvolvedores(as) de sistemas/aplicações Web, para colaborar na construção de aplicativos seguros, escaláveis e de alto desempenho. O profissional atuará no ciclo de desenvolvimento completo de projetos existentes e novos projetos, desde a sua conceituação (escopo, analise, entendimento), desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Projetar e desenvolver aplicativos Web eficientes, tanto para a execução no servidor como nos browsers, com possibilidades de instalação na nuvem;

  • Executar as atividades de todas as fases do ciclo do desenvolvimento e implantação dos aplicativos, usando metodologias ágeis;
  • Colaborar na definição da solução técnica aos requisitos de negócio, junto a área de produtos e junto aos clientes, implementando-a de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Criar códigos bem projetados, testáveis, eficientes, seguros e aderentes às necessidades de negócio e com a arquitetura de referência corporativa;
  • Desenvolver garantindo a qualidade e a manutenibilidade do código, zelando por sua documentação e projetando/executando testes unitários e de integração;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de desenvolvimento, atuando como replicador de conhecimento e das boas práticas corporativas.
  • Proatividade, ética e senso de ownership para assumir responsabilidades, entregar resultados consistentes e colaborar ativamente para o sucesso do time e dos projetos.
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, garantindo entregas consistentes e sem retrabalho, avaliando alternativas para cada situação e mantendo altos padrões mesmo sob pressão ou prazos desafiadores.
  • Foco em resultados, garantindo entregas de alto impacto, superando desafios e agregando valor de forma consistente, mesmo em condições desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Graduação Completa em Engenharia de Software, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia (outras especialidades), Matemática ou Física;

  • Experiência avançada em desenvolvimento de aplicação Web (Web App) de alta performance;
  • Experiência avançada com PHP;
  • Experiência com frameworks de mercado (Laravel, Zend ou Symfony);
  • Experiência com HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, JQuery, JavaScript, ReactJS;
  • Experiência na aplicação de arquitetura para projetos PHP e \"design patterns\";
  • Experiência avançada em base de dados (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL e MongoDB);
  • Experiência com Github
  • Experiência com as seguintes aplicações KeyCloak, RabittMQ Docker, DBEaver, MailHog, entre outras
  • Experiência ambientes Linux / Apache
  • OOP, Web Services, APIs Restfull, XML, SOA;
  • Sistema de Filas/Mensagerias (RabbitMQ);
  • Serviços em Nuvem AWS, GCP e Azure;
  • Experiência com qualidade de codificação e boas práticas tais como: testes unitários.
  • Conhecimento/participação de processos ágeis de desenvolvimento com experiência em metodologia ágil Scrum, XP, Agile.
  • Protagonismo (autodidata, assumir desafios, engajado) e capacidade de trabalho em equipes auto gerenciáveis.
  • Uso de assistentes de IA para codificação (ex: SuperMaven, Copilot, Gemini, OpenIA, Vercel AI, Lhama, Claude);

Requisitos e qualificações:

Certificações nos ambientes, e tecnologias descritas anteriormente

  • Conhecimento de outras linguagens (Java, Python)
  • Certificações web, qualidade de código, metodologia ágeis, etc

title: Senior Salesforce Admin
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Admin

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration : 6 Months

Need to support PST hours

Level: Salesforce Administrator or higher

Salesforce Certified Administrator – required

About the Role

CriticalRiver’s Salesforce Studio is seeking a Salesforce Admin / Support Analyst to provide day-to-day support for our GTM (Go-to-Market) systems team. This role will focus on managing support requests, enabling end users, and partnering with developers to ensure smooth delivery of enhancements and projects. The ideal candidate has strong Salesforce administration skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience working in fast-paced, Agile environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the first line of support for Salesforce GTM systems users, addressing tickets and troubleshooting issues.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into well-defined user stories for the development team.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA, and business stakeholders to support the delivery of enhancements and fixes.
  • Coordinate and facilitate demos, UAT sessions, and enablement activities to ensure smooth adoption of new functionality.
  • Manage Salesforce configuration, including user management, profiles, roles, page layouts, validation rules, and automation (Flows).
  • Provide documentation and training materials to support ongoing user adoption.
  • Monitor Salesforce platform releases and recommend improvements.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of Salesforce administration experience supporting business teams.
  • Strong skills in Salesforce configuration (users, roles, profiles, page layouts, validation rules, flows).
  • Experience writing and managing user stories in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
  • Strong coordination and facilitation skills (demos, enablement, UAT).
  • Excellent communication skills in English with the ability to interact with end users and technical teams.
  • Nearshore availability (LATAM strongly preferred).
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator – required.
  • Additional Salesforce certifications (e.g., Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder) are a plus.
